exodus.25.p1.b1.text: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.

exodus.25.p1.b2.text: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze; blue, purple, and scarlet yarn …

exodus.25.p1.b3.text: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.

exodus.25.p2.b4.text: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

exodus.25.p2.b5.text: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.

exodus.25.p2.b6.text: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.

exodus.25.p2.b7.text: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

exodus.25.p3.b8.text: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,

exodus.25.p3.b9.text: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.

exodus.25.p3.b10.text: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony …

exodus.25.p4.b11.text: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.

exodus.25.p4.b12.text: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.

exodus.25.p4.b13.text: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.

exodus.25.p5.b14.text: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.

exodus.25.p5.b15.text: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.

exodus.25.p5.b16.text: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
